concept.hr: Klonovi iste slike dijele jedan client ID, pa ih WSUS vidi kao jedno računalo
concept.en: Cloned images share one client ID, so many machines show as one

summary.hr: Tri klona s istom oznakom klijenta: konzola ima jedan redak koji prepisuje zadnji koji se javi. Generalizirana slika i brisanje oznake.
summary.en: Three clones with one client ID: the console keeps one row, overwritten by whoever reports last. A generalised image, and resetting the ID.
